name: print-social-be-an-influencer-stories-yellow-pink-green-bold-blocks
title: 'Be an Influencer' story set in yellow, pink, purple and green blocks with sticker icons and a phone selfie photo
whatItIs: Ten vertical story cards in alternating bold yellow, pink, purple and green blocks, with a woman taking a phone selfie, sticker-style icons (target, planet, lightbulb, eye, computer), repeated 'Influencer' text patterns, and headlines ('Be an Influencer', 'How to create new content', 'Digital Influencer', 'Plan your content').
whatItMeans: Loud and youthful; clashing bold colour blocks and sticker icons speak directly to a social-media-native audience.
techniques: Alternate several bold colour blocks across a large story set.
Scatter sticker-style icons for a playful social-media feel.
Repeat the campaign word as background texture.

vocabulary.definition: A small illustration with a bold outline, like a digital sticker.
Switching between several solid background colours across a set.
